name: EPIC 205977740
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 7.5 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205977740 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.544894 (16th-84th percentiles 7.320302-7.812424), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205977740: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4696.7554 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205977740 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2815.078125 (16th-84th percentiles 2740.585938-2895.9375), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,815 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.89 solar masses and 7.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,697 K at its surface.
